# Coqfight Spine assets

> Chikn and Roostr characters from the game Coqfight, as Spine 4.2 skeletons with texture atlases. Load them with any official Spine 4.2 runtime (spine-canvas, spine-webgl, spine-pixi, spine-phaser, spine-unity, spine-godot and so on).

Docs for people: docs.html on this site. A working web example: example.html.

## Files (relative to this site; replace "chikn" with "roostr" for the other series)
- v1/chikn/chikn.json: Spine 4.2 skeleton JSON. 68 bones, 66 slots, 21 body skins, 174 trait skins (224 on roostr), 41 animations.
- v1/chikn/chikn.atlas: Spine 4.x atlas. Region names equal attachment paths. Pages live in v1/chikn/atlas/. Each body skin has its own page (atlas/<Body>.png) and each trait has its own page (atlas/trait-<trait>.png).
- v1/chikn/images/<Skin>/<Part>.png: the same art as loose PNGs, for the Spine editor.
- v1/chikn/chikn-animations-meta.json: per-animation loop flags; scriptCurves.RelativeX is the game's lunge toward the opponent (not in the skeleton).
- v1/traits/traits.json: trait catalogue (series, parts, thumbnail path, sound effect names).
- v1/traits/trait-rules.json: base parts to hide when a trait has a *.Special part.
- latest/ is an alias of the newest version folder. v1 only gets non-breaking fixes.
- All files are served with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.

## How to build a coq
1. Load the atlas text and skeleton JSON; parse with new spine.TextureAtlas(text) and new spine.SkeletonJson(new spine.AtlasAttachmentLoader(atlas)).readSkeletonData(json). Parsing does not need textures.
2. Make a new spine.Skin, addSkin(the body skin, e.g. "Bullion"), then addSkin("trait/<name>") for each trait.
3. Hide rules: if the combined skin has an attachment in slot Head.Special, remove the Head.Comb attachment. Same for Tail.Special -> Tail, Front.Leg.Foot.Special -> Front.Leg.Foot, Back.Leg.Foot.Special -> Back.Leg.Foot.
4. Use at most one trait per slot.
5. On the web, only load the atlas pages used by the combined skin's attachments (attachment.region.page), then page.setTexture(...). Engines that load every page will load about 27 MB (chikn) or 37 MB (roostr).
6. skeleton.setSkin(skin); skeleton.setSlotsToSetupPose(); play animations with AnimationState, e.g. "Idle" looping.

## Naming
- Body skins: Chikn: Bayc, Bullion, Celestial, CryptoPunk, Crystale, Crystalé, Degen, DirtyBird, Elon, FrogNationGreen, GameBoy, Kernel, MutantPurple, NightstalkerBlue, PassionRed, Pepe, Pixel-Chan, PixelChan, RusticBrown, Space, SweatyMeatChikn. Roostr: Beast, Bullion, Captain, Celestial, CuteGravy, FrogGreen, Gumball, Gunslinger, Hypnocoq, Lava, Midnight, Monotone, MutantBlue, MutantGreen, MutantPurple, NightstalkerBlue, Obsidian, PassionRed, Robot, SnowWhite, Split.
- Trait skins: "trait/chikn_*" on chikn only, "trait/roostr_*" on roostr only, unprefixed ones on both. Full list in traits.json.
- Animations: Idle, IdleHurt, Hurt, Death, Buff, Pray, Counter, BlockMelee, BlockRanged, Punch, Kick, Kick_Space, WhirlwindKick, Headbutt, Slash, Thrust, Thrust_Beast, Baseball, Throw, ThrowLow, ThrowLow_Degen, OverheadThrow, PistolShot, RifleShot, RayCast, RayCast_Unique, SpellCast, SpellCast_Unique, SpellCastLow, SpellCastLow_Unique, Shine, Shine_Hypnocoq, TailProjectile, TailProjectile_Unique.
- Extra locomotion animations (not from the game, play in place): Walk, Run, Flap, Victory (loop); Jump, Hop, Peck (play once).

## Units and gaps
- Pixels, 100 per game unit, y up, root bone at the feet. A coq is roughly 1,600 px tall.
- Particle effects and sounds are not included; Death ends with the coq hidden.

## Licence
- The art is released under the Chikn Community Asset Licence (license.html, plain text at LICENSE.md). Non-commercial use is free; commercial use needs a separate agreement (royalty-free up to AUD $100,000 cumulative gross revenue, 10% above). Visible attribution is required, e.g. "Contains assets © Chikn. Used under licence. https://chikn.farm". Do not resell the original assets as standalone packs.
- The official Spine runtimes require each user to hold their own Spine Editor licence.
